content.text: Let me check what the age bracket data looks like and what month codes are available:

input.sql: SELECT * FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_AGE_BRACKET ORDER BY AGE_BEN_SNDS
SELECT DISTINCT FLX_ANN_MOI FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS ORDER BY FLX_ANN_MOI DESC LIMIT 10

content.text: Now let me query for the reimbursement amounts by age bracket for January 2025 (202501), excluding unknown age (99):

input.sql:
SELECT 
    dab.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB,
    SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT + COALESCE(fr.FLT_REM_MNT, 0)) as total_reimbursed
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_AGE_BRACKET dab ON fr.AGE_BEN_SNDS = dab.AGE_BEN_SNDS
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501
    AND dab.AGE_BEN_SNDS != 99
GROUP BY dab.AGE_BEN_SNDS, dab.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB
ORDER BY dab.AGE_BEN_SNDS

content.text: Perfect! I have the answer. Let me provide the final SQL query:

input.final_sql:
SELECT 
    dab.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB as age_bracket_name,
    SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT + COALESCE(fr.FLT_REM_MNT, 0)) as amount_reimbursed
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_AGE_BRACKET dab ON fr.AGE_BEN_SNDS = dab.AGE_BEN_SNDS
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501
    AND dab.AGE_BEN_SNDS != 99
GROUP BY dab.AGE_BEN_SNDS, dab.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB
ORDER BY dab.AGE_BEN_SNDS
